name: royalty-statement
title: Royalty statement
for_each: select s.id, s.ref || ' ' || w.title || ' ' || p.name as name from statements s join contracts c on c.id = s.contract_id join works w on w.id = c.work_id join contributors p on p.id = c.contributor_id where s.status <> 'draft'

sections.title: Statement
sections.sql: select p.name as payee, p.agent, w.title, c.ref as contract, rp.name as period, s.status, s.due_on from statements s join contracts c on c.id = s.contract_id join works w on w.id = c.work_id join contributors p on p.id = c.contributor_id join royalty_periods rp on rp.id = s.period_id where s.id = $1

sections.title: Sales and royalties
sections.sql: select coalesce(e.isbn, '') as isbn, l.description, l.units, case l.basis when 'rrp' then 'RRP' when 'net_receipts' then 'Net receipts' else '' end as basis, l.rate_bps, l.base_cents, l.royalty_cents, s.currency from statement_lines l join statements s on s.id = l.statement_id left join editions e on e.id = l.edition_id where l.statement_id = $1 order by l.line_type, e.ref, l.channel, l.rate_bps

sections.title: Your account
sections.note: A negative balance is advance not yet earned out. The reserve held against returns is released on the next statement.
sections.sql: select opening_cents as opening_balance_cents, -advances_paid_cents as advances_paid_this_period_cents, earned_cents as royalties_earned_cents, subrights_cents as rights_income_share_cents, reserve_released_cents, -reserve_held_cents as reserve_held_cents, balance_cents as closing_balance_cents, gross_payable_cents, -withholding_cents as withholding_tax_cents, gst_cents, net_payment_cents, carry_forward_cents, currency from statements where id = $1

name: remittance-advice
title: Remittance advice
for_each: select s.id, s.ref || ' ' || p.name as name from statements s join contracts c on c.id = s.contract_id join contributors p on p.id = c.contributor_id where s.status in ('approved', 'sent', 'paid') and s.net_payment_cents > 0

sections.title: Payment
sections.note: Where GST is shown, this document is issued by the publisher as the tax invoice under the written agreement recorded with the payee.
sections.sql: select p.name as payee, nullif(p.gst_number, '') as payee_gst_number, p.tax_country as tax_residence, w.title, rp.name as period, s.gross_payable_cents as royalties_cents, s.gst_cents, s.withholding_cents as withholding_tax_cents, s.net_payment_cents, s.currency, s.paid_on from statements s join contracts c on c.id = s.contract_id join works w on w.id = c.work_id join contributors p on p.id = c.contributor_id join royalty_periods rp on rp.id = s.period_id where s.id = $1

name: advance-information-sheet
title: Advance information sheet
for_each: select e.id, e.ref || ' ' || w.title as name from editions e join works w on w.id = e.work_id where e.pub_date > current_date

sections.title: Title
sections.sql: select w.title, (select string_agg(p.name, ' and ' order by c.ref) from contracts c join contributors p on p.id = c.contributor_id where c.work_id = w.id) as by, i.name as imprint, e.format, e.isbn, e.rrp_cents, i.currency, e.pub_date, e.print_run from editions e join works w on w.id = e.work_id join imprints i on i.id = w.imprint_id where e.id = $1

sections.title: Other editions
sections.sql: select o.format, o.isbn, o.pub_date, o.rrp_cents, i.currency from editions e join editions o on o.work_id = e.work_id and o.id <> e.id join works w on w.id = e.work_id join imprints i on i.id = w.imprint_id where e.id = $1 order by o.pub_date
